rationale.purpose: Implement requested elemental attacks and concrete art revisions in the existing sandbox, preserving the liked fire combo.
rationale.decision_source: User requests И fire combo binding, outward earth eruptions, actual End portal diagonal tear, VFX-only Void/Sculk; later correction requires adaptive Blockbench Bloom roots, brown thick lower roots, green pointed leaves, exact existing model+UV Pairs, independent animation for each branch and orange-to-dark magma stones. Codex chooses tick14 teleport, five wave placements, 90-tick model hold, native shader aperture runs, source-owned native OBJ bake and external layered material/cel painting. Later user explicitly requests full hostile suppression, +/-10Y eruption support with connected ground/fire VFX, visible Sculk surfaces, below40% guardian shield/resistance/golem with180degree facing correction, removal of stale-position Void targeting and all missing B utilities. Latest root steering says no further smoothing, make lower pieces chunkier. Codex chooses narrow mapped whole-action-tick pause plus native baseTick clocks/event guards, preserves old behavior outside sandbox and uses canonical local utility contracts, safe golem clearance and normal-native temporary path persistence.
